text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower pulls out all the stops at<n>the Japanese
Derby and beats<n>Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But she can't let up just because<n>she managed to
win this time.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the long-distance Kikuka<n>Sho, where she
will face off against<n>Mihono Bourbon once again.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This upcoming race will be<n>make-or-break for a
stayer like Rice<n>Shower, so it's back to training for
us.
